transcript: I started off with my most preferred being the modern green utopia because I feel as though we should be moving towards more of a sustainable society when it comes to how we act within our daily lives and what actions that we take to continuously reach more sustainable goals. I then chose the future utopia because while I do like science and innovation and I do think that they're pivotal in the way that we continuously grow as a society. I believe freedom of religion is one of the best parts about most of the countries in our modern world, and yet we can't, you know, without freedom of religion, a lot of things go wrong. So a faith-based order seems very wild to me.
